description: This file defines the 'FieldToList' class, a method operation for the MiniLang language in the OFBiz framework. It implements the <field-to-list> element, which adds a field value to a list within the method context, and includes a factory class for creating instances.

classes.name: FieldToList
classes.description: A method operation that converts a specified field into a list element within the method context.

classes.name: FieldToListFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of FieldToList.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the operation: retrieves a field value and adds it to a list in the environment map.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the FieldToList instance.

methods.name: createMethodOperation
methods.description: Factory method to create a new FieldToList instance.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the operation element, 'field-to-list'.
